name: Backspin: Reverse Singing
subtitle: Backwards voice party game
promotionalText: Say a line, hear it backwards, copy it and see how close you get. Your first 10 goes are free with everything on, then one lifetime unlock. No ads.
description:
Your voice, with a twist.

Record a short line, hear it played backwards, then try to copy that strange new sound. Backspin flips your attempt forwards again. The result? A wonderfully wobbly version of what you started with, and a real score for how close you got.

HOW TO PLAY
• Say a line, or pick one of 950+ challenge lines
• Listen to it backwards (loop it or slow it down)
• Copy the backwards sound
• Backspin flips your copy and scores it out of 100 for sound, rhythm and length

BRING EVERYONE IN
• Party mode for 2 to 8 players on one phone, with rounds and a scoreboard
• Copy it: highest closeness wins. Guess it: decode the backwards line
• Challenge a friend: they record, you copy
• A daily challenge with streaks and a score to share
• Save takes and share a four-part clip: original, backwards, your copy and flipped

7 PACKS OF ORIGINAL LINES
Warm-ups, party lines, animals and sound effects, family and kids, tongue twisters, public-domain song lines and Aussie phrases. Plus voice effects: chipmunk, giant, robot, echo and alien.

FREE TO TRY, THEN YOURS FOR LIFE
Your first 10 goes are free with every pack, effect and party size switched on. After that, Backspin Plus is one small payment that unlocks unlimited goes for life. No subscription, no ads, ever. Saved takes always play and share.

PRIVATE
No account. No tracking. Backspin records when you use the record button (hold or tap mode), and your recordings stay on your phone unless you share them.

inAppPurchases.reviewNote: Non-consumable lifetime unlock. The first 10 scored rounds are free with everything on (the Play tab shows the goes left); after that a new round shows this unlock screen. Test: Play tab > free goes badge (or Settings > Backspin Plus) > Unlock; Restore purchase is on the same screen.

reviewNotes:
No account or login. Backspin is a reverse-singing game: Play tab > Quick play, hold the red button and say the line, listen to it backwards, hold the button again to copy the backwards sound, and Backspin flips the copy and scores it. The microphone records only during a user-started take (hold mode by default, or tap to start/stop in Settings); all audio processing is on the device and recordings are not uploaded. Pricing: the first 10 scored rounds ('goes') are free with every feature on, stated on the Play tab and the unlock screen; after that new rounds need 'Backspin Plus' (non-consumable, one-time lifetime unlock), with Restore purchase on the same screen. Saved takes still play without it. All challenge lines are original or public domain; no copyrighted lyrics. App Privacy declares Device ID and Crash Data used for app functionality: Expo EAS Update sends a random installation identifier and failed-update diagnostics. No identity linkage or tracking.

App Review information:
1. Testing: TestFlight build 7 recording, playback, sharing, Plus purchase and Restore were tested on a physical iPhone and confirmed by the developer on 26 October 2026.
2. Purpose and audience: a party game for friends and families (ages 4+). Players say a line, hear it reversed, try to copy the reversed sound, and the app flips their copy back and scores how close it is. It turns a viral video trend into a quick game with no setup.
3. Setup: no login or sample files needed. Play tab > Quick play, then hold the red button.
4. External services: Apple In-App Purchase (StoreKit) for the optional lifetime unlock, and Expo EAS Update for app-code updates. Audio is processed on the device and is never uploaded by the app; no accounts, behavioral analytics, ads or AI processing. EAS Update receives a random installation identifier and technical failed-launch diagnostics for update delivery/recovery, declared in App Privacy.
5. Regional differences: none; works the same in all regions (only the purchase price is localised).
6. Regulated industry / third-party material: not applicable; challenge lines are original or public domain.
